test_python_callbacks_to_cpp: test passing Python functions, lambdas, and partials as callbacks into C++ via pybind11 bindings
test_bound_method_callbacks: test passing Python and C++ bound methods as callbacks to C++ functions through pybind11
test_keyword_args_unpacking: test tuple unpacking, dict unpacking, and keyword argument passing from C++ to Python callbacks
test_lambda_closure_cleanup: test that lambda closures holding C++ objects are properly cleaned up and garbage collected
test_cpp_function_roundtrip: test passing C++ function pointers through Python and back to C++ to verify pointer identity
